coreMemory.chinese: 带领；领导；领路；领先；导致；促使
coreMemory.english: v. to guide, direct, or be in charge of people；v. to go first and show the way；v. to cause or result in something
coreMemory.structure: lead a team /liːd ə ˈtiːm/（带领团队）；lead someone somewhere /liːd ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈsʌmˌwɛr/（带某人去某处）；lead someone through something /liːd ˈsʌmˌwʌn ˈθruː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（引导某人完成某事）；lead to something /liːd ˈtuː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（导致某事）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ lead a busy living → ✅ lead a busy life；❌ It leaded to a delay → ✅ It led to a delay

commonErrors.note: 表示“过着……的生活”的固定搭配是 lead a ... life
lead 的普通过去式是 led，不是 leaded

coreMemory.exampleChinese: 她带领一个小型设计团队。

meanings.english: to guide, direct, or be in charge of people
to go first and show the way
meanings.example: A guide led us through the cave.
meanings.translation: 一名向导带我们穿过洞穴。

meanings.english: to cause or result in something
meanings.example: Stress can lead to poor sleep.
meanings.translation: 压力可能导致睡眠不佳。

items.chinese: 以身作则带领初级员工
引导调查人员找到嫌疑人

items.phrase: lead a discussion with a question

fixedPhrases.example: She leads a twelve-person research team.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她带领一支十二人的研究团队。

fixedPhrases.example: A volunteer led us to the emergency exit.
fixedPhrases.translation: 一名志愿者带我们去了紧急出口。

fixedPhrases.example: The nurse led me through each step of the procedure.
fixedPhrases.translation: 护士引导我完成了这项操作的每一步。

fixedPhrases.example: Poor drainage can lead to serious flooding.
fixedPhrases.translation: 排水不良可能导致严重洪水。

fixedPhrases.example: The new evidence led investigators to reopen the case.
fixedPhrases.translation: 新证据促使调查人员重启案件。

fixedPhrases.example: Local schools are leading the way in waste reduction.
fixedPhrases.translation: 当地学校在减少废弃物方面走在前列。

fixedPhrases.example: Good supervisors lead by example rather than by threats.
fixedPhrases.translation: 优秀的主管以身作则，而不是靠威胁。

fixedPhrases.example: Despite leading a busy life, he calls his parents weekly.
fixedPhrases.translation: 尽管生活忙碌，他每周仍给父母打电话。

fixedPhrases.example: The company leads the market in battery safety.
fixedPhrases.translation: 该公司在电池安全领域领跑市场。

fixedPhrases.example: Mina took the lead in organizing the relief effort.
fixedPhrases.translation: 米娜带头组织了救援工作。

fixedPhrases.example: Our runner remained in the lead until the final lap.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们的选手直到最后一圈仍处于领先。

fixedPhrases.example: Other cities soon followed Seoul's lead.
fixedPhrases.translation: 其他城市很快效仿了首尔。

coreMemory.english: v. to keep happening or doing something without stopping；v. to begin again after an interruption
coreMemory.structure: continue doing something /kənˈtɪnjuː ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（继续做某事）；continue to do something /kənˈtɪnjuː ˈtuː ˈduː ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（继续做某事）；continue with something /kənˈtɪnjuː ˈwɪð ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（继续某事）；continue a conversation /kənˈtɪnjuː ə ˌkɑnvɚˈseɪʃən/（继续谈话）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ continue to working → ✅ continue to work / continue working；❌ We continued from the break at two. → ✅ We continued after the break at two.

commonErrors.note: continue 可接 to do 或 doing，不可混成 to doing

commonErrors.wrong: We continued from the break at two.
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /ˈwiː kənˈtɪnjud ˈfrʌm ðə ˈbreɪk ˈæt ˈtuː/
commonErrors.right: We continued after the break at two.
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /ˈwiː kənˈtɪnjud ˈæftɚ ðə ˈbreɪk ˈæt ˈtuː/
commonErrors.note: continue after a break 表示休息后接着进行；from 需引出明确的内容或中断位置

coreMemory.directSynonym: persist /pɚˈsɪst/（持续；坚持）；proceed /prəˈsiːd/（继续进行；前进）；carry on /ˈkæri ˈɑn/（继续）；maintain /meɪnˈteɪn/（维持）；keep up /ˈkiːp ˈʌp/（继续保持）

meanings.english: to keep happening or doing something without stopping
to begin again after an interruption
meanings.example: We continued the meeting after lunch.

items.chinese: 尽管遭到强烈批评仍继续

fixedPhrases.example: She continued working after a short break.
fixedPhrases.translation: 短暂休息后她继续工作。

fixedPhrases.example: The river continues to rise after the storm.
fixedPhrases.translation: 暴风雨后河水仍在上涨。

fixedPhrases.example: After lunch, we continued with the second part of the workshop.
fixedPhrases.translation: 午饭后我们继续研讨会的第二部分。

fixedPhrases.example: They continued their conversation outside the theater.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他们在剧院外继续交谈。

fixedPhrases.example: Once the road reopened, we continued our journey north.
fixedPhrases.translation: 道路重开后，我们继续向北行程。

fixedPhrases.example: The exhibition will continue until the end of May.
fixedPhrases.translation: 展览将持续到五月底。

fixedPhrases.example: Heavy rain continued for three days.
fixedPhrases.translation: 大雨持续了三天。

fixedPhrases.example: Until a replacement arrives, the service will continue as before.
fixedPhrases.translation: 替代方案到位前，服务将照旧运行。

fixedPhrases.example: Demand for clean water continued unabated.
fixedPhrases.translation: 对清洁用水的需求丝毫未减。

fixedPhrases.example: After checking the map, the hikers continued on their way.
fixedPhrases.translation: 查看地图后，徒步者继续赶路。

fixedPhrases.example: The message said the story would be continued next week.
fixedPhrases.translation: 消息称故事将在下周继续。

fixedPhrases.phrase: continue from where one left off
fixedPhrases.example: Tomorrow we will continue from where we left off today.
fixedPhrases.translation: 明天我们将从今天中断的地方继续。

antonyms.usage: 与继续活动或过程相反；是否含中断、及物结构和持续状态均不相同

derivatives.note: 指动作的延续或故事、道路等的接续部分

coreMemory.chinese: 花费金钱；花费；度过时间
coreMemory.english: v. to use money to pay for things；v. to use time or pass a period in a particular way
coreMemory.structure: spend money on something /spend ˈmʌni ˈɑn ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（在某物上花钱）；spend money doing something /spend ˈmʌni ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（花钱做某事）；spend time doing something /spend ˈtaɪm ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ/（花时间做某事）；spend time with someone /spend ˈtaɪm ˈwɪð ˈsʌmˌwʌn/（与某人共度时光）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ spend money for clothes → ✅ spend money on clothes；❌ spend two hours to finish it → ✅ spend two hours finishing it

commonErrors.note: spend + 金钱 + on + 物；若强调购买行为可说 spend money buying clothes

commonErrors.wrong: spend two hours to finish it
commonErrors.note: spend + 时间 + doing，不用 spend time to do

coreMemory.directSynonym: expend /ɪkˈspɛnd/（花费；消耗）；consume /kənˈsuːm/（消耗；耗费）；devote /dɪˈvoʊt/（投入）；pass /ˈpæs/（度过）；disburse /dɪsˈbɝːs/（支付；拨付）
coreMemory.example: I spend twenty minutes reviewing words each day.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 我每天花二十分钟复习单词。

meanings.english: to use money to pay for things
meanings.example: She spent fifty dollars on books.

meanings.english: to use time or pass a period in a particular way
meanings.example: We spent the afternoon at the museum.
meanings.translation: 我们在博物馆度过了下午。

items.chinese: 花费超出自己的经济能力

items.phrase: spend the winter near the coast

fixedPhrases.example: We spent most of the budget on safety equipment.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们把大部分预算花在了安全设备上。

fixedPhrases.example: They spent thousands restoring the old theater.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他们花费数千元修复这座老剧院。

fixedPhrases.example: I spend an hour reading every evening.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我每天晚上花一小时阅读。

fixedPhrases.example: She spent the weekend with her grandparents.
fixedPhrases.translation: 她和祖父母一起度过了周末。

fixedPhrases.example: We spent a day exploring the old town.
fixedPhrases.translation: 我们花了一天游览古城。

fixedPhrases.example: The climbers spent the night in a mountain shelter.
fixedPhrases.translation: 登山者在山间避难所过夜。

fixedPhrases.example: He spent a fortune on repairs to the roof.
fixedPhrases.translation: 他花了一大笔钱修屋顶。

fixedPhrases.example: Families are spending more wisely during the downturn.
fixedPhrases.translation: 经济低迷期间，各家消费更加理性。

fixedPhrases.example: The adviser urged us to spend within our means.
fixedPhrases.translation: 顾问劝我们量入为出。

fixedPhrases.example: Do not spend all your energy on minor details.
fixedPhrases.translation: 不要把全部精力花在次要细节上。

fixedPhrases.example: The morning at the science museum was time well spent.
